aesthetic_philosophy: Premium tech, investment firm, AI research organisation. Highly engineered, bare-metal minimalism, confident, spacious. NO robots, NO AI faces, NO generic SaaS gradients.

typography.heading_strategy: Use Cabinet Grotesk. Extreme tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive impact. Contrast weights drastically: use font-light for elegant philosophical statements and font-bold for bold structural headers. NEVER center-align hero text; enforce strong left-alignment.
typography.body_strategy: Use Manrope for extreme legibility and a slight technical edge. Loose line heights (leading-relaxed).
typography.overline_strategy: Use JetBrains Mono or Manrope uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs. Use for section labels and card numbers (e.g., '01 // DISCOVER').

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. The site must feel expansive and expensive.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Swiss Grid. Use border-collapse CSS or grid item borders (border-r, border-b) to expose the structural grid. No floating soft cards.
layout_and_spacing.radius: Hyper-minimal. Use rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm. No rounded-lg or rounded-xl.

header.style: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70. 1px bottom border of border-white/10. Sticky top-0 z-50.
header.brand: 'imk.' logo (lowercase) with the red dot (using text-[#E60000] for the dot).

buttons.primary: Solid #E60000 background, pure white text, rounded-none, px-8 py-4. Hover: scale slightly, brighten to #FF3333.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px border border-white/20, pure white text, rounded-none. Hover: bg-white/10.

inputs.style: Do NOT use default Shadcn boxes. Inputs must be pure HTML-style naked inputs with only a bottom border (border-b border-white/20), bg-transparent, rounded-none, px-0. On focus: border-[#E60000] and outline-none.

cards.style: Cardless approach or flat surfaces (#0A0A0A) with 1px sharp borders. No box-shadow. Hover states should include a 1px border color shift to #E60000 or an inner glow.

motion_and_interactions.hero_background: TSParticles instance acting as a mesh network. 99% of nodes and links are dark grey (#222222). Exactly ONE node (or a very small cluster) is pure Imkindo Red (#E60000) representing the 'intelligence point'.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion. Use staggered, slow upward reveals (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> 1, duration: 0.8s).
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle and sharp. Text brightness increases, borders illuminate, no bouncy physics.

icons.usage: Use sparingly. Arrows for CTAs (ArrowUpRight), abstract symbols for Value Creation.

images.description: Dark cinematic abstract lines representing data flow. Used conditionally if TSParticles is disabled or as a subtle blend behind it.
Dark minimalist building corner. Use as a low-opacity background blend in the 'How We Create Value' section to add architectural structure.
Intricate geometric architectural design with dramatic light/shadow. High-end, premium.
Modern premium corporate office interior (dark). Use as a background for the contact form area with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/80).

hero.content: Headline: 'Building intelligent solutions for a changing world.' left-aligned. Red dot in 'imk.' logo. TSParticles network behind.

positioning.layout: Massive typographic statement centered or heavy left. 'Human insight. Artificial intelligence. Real-world impact.' (Highlighting 'Artificial intelligence' in italics or subtle red). Add the 25+ years experience narrative in a smaller secondary column.

value_creation.layout: Grid of 3. Strict 1px borders forming a structural grid. 01 Discover, 02 Build, 03 Scale.

ventures.layout: Two distinct asymmetric blocks showcasing NowAgentAI™ and NowMoveMe™. Include specific external link arrows. Avoid software mockups; use typography and geometric shapes to represent them.

partnerships.layout: Sleek, image-backed section using the Innovation image. Emphasize scale and institutional trust.

contact.layout: 2-column. Left: 'Start a Conversation' with deep padding. Right: Stacked form fields (Name, Company, Position, Email, Phone, Country, Message) and 2 Shadcn Selects (Interested In, Organisation Type) stripped of default styling to match the bare-metal input look.

footer.layout: Massive py-20. Bottom border layout. Copyright © Imkindo Ltd, and trademarked venture names.

testing_requirements.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, dropdowns) MUST include a data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='hero-explore-ventures-button', data-testid='contact-name-input'.

tech_stack_overrides.components: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural and marketing sections to ensure total freedom of layout. ONLY use Shadcn for complex logic (Select dropdowns).
tech_stack_overrides.file_type: Ensure all implementations are written in .js/.jsx, not .tsx.
